note: Two miles up an access road off Tripoli Road (I-93 exit 31), on a wooded hillside above 40-acre Russell Pond, with a boat ramp, dock and beach (no power boats). Most sites are tent sites; the RV spurs are in the E, F and G loops. Two pets per site. --Claude
summary: FS page + map + rec.gov 273778: 86 sites, mostly tent; 11 RV spurs take 24-40 ft on rec.gov (8 reservable); $30 + $6 per vehicle past an RV and tow car; flush toilets, coin showers, water; mid-May to mid-October; 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin ~330 m south of the loops; phone -> concessionaire.
